actions.title: Recover real DOIs for 92 source pages currently marked no_doi_assigned with Scholar fallback
actions.closes_what: provenance debt from 2026-05-13 publish run (wiki/lint/2026-05-13-doi-fallback-followup.md); restores real DOI + publisher access URLs in place of Scholar search fallbacks
actions.best_dispatched_to: Claude Code Opus (small structured edits, occasional DOI lookup)
actions.details: Each page has its raw_path pointing to the Marker-converted markdown. DOI is usually on page 1 of the paper; if not, query Crossref / OpenAlex / Semantic Scholar by title+author+year. Replace doi: null + no_doi_assigned: true + Scholar URL with the real DOI + matching publisher access_url. If no DOI exists after exhaustive search, keep no_doi_assigned: true but replace the Scholar URL with a venue/publisher URL.

actions.title: Populate 1965 *[awaiting synthesis]* cells in source-legend tables across 280 pages
actions.closes_what: the "Used on this page for" column in the hmi-source-legend table on every product, ingredient, and metal page — the brand-legal-facing scannable provenance surface Karen prioritized as standard format on 2026-05-13
actions.best_dispatched_to: Claude Code Opus (per-source contextual synthesis at scale)
actions.details: 1965 cells across 280 pages. Each cell needs a 1-sentence description of what the source contributes to this specific page. Read the source page TL;DR + the consumer page body, then patch the cell. Idempotent: re-running on already-filled cells is a no-op.

actions.title: Fix 13 food/personal-care source pages with products: [] (Phase 1 gate)
actions.closes_what: routing-discipline failures per docs/order-of-operations.md Phase 1. Each source has matrices declaring product-shaped slugs but products: [] and no pending_category_lock flag. Either declare products: with matching slug(s) from the existing taxonomy, or set pending_category_lock: <name> if the target category is not yet locked.
actions.best_dispatched_to: Claude Code (small structured edits; may need --include-medium reverse-route)
actions.details: Most of today's 13 fails are medium-confidence map entries (fish → fresh-fish, dried-herbs → spices, vegetable-juice → vegetable-juices-non-root). Quick fix: run `npm run reverse-route:apply -- --include-medium` to apply medium-confidence proposals after Karen reviews them. Alternative fix: hand-edit each source to declare the correct product slug.

actions.details: 33 cells blocked because no source provides concentration data for the (product, metal) combination. The wishlist generator can target these specifically by injecting product+metal queries; auto-fetch then runs against the expanded queries.

actions.title: Investigate 15 HMTc-locked product pages with zero routed sources (Phase 5 gate)
actions.closes_what: scaffolded HMTc rows that never received their Phase 1 ingest. Each row is a brand-legal-facing page where the literature evidence is currently empty, which means the page reads as unsupported on the live site. Some may legitimately have thin literature (matcha, sports-energy-drinks); others may be misroutes.
actions.best_dispatched_to: Karen (decide per-row: thin literature vs misroute) + Claude follow-through
actions.details: Today's failures: baby-lotion-cream, baby-oil, baby-powder-cornstarch, baby-shampoo-body-wash, baby-sunscreen-chemical, baby-sunscreen-mineral, baby-wipes, childrens-nail-polish, diaper-cream-non-zno, diaper-cream-zno, flavored-waters, matcha, soft-drinks-carbonated-beverages, sports-energy-drinks, vegetable-juices-root-vegetable-containing. For each row, check whether (a) the corpus has sources that should route but their frontmatter is wrong, (b) the matrix vocabulary needs an entry in data/evidence/matrix-to-product-map.json, or (c) the literature is genuinely thin and the page should carry a "literature is thin for this row" caveat.
